page.notes: The first word "postolus" appears to lack its first letter at the left edge; the likely reading is "apostolus", so it is marked [?]. "fese" is doubtful, marked [?]. The Greek "τύπον" is copied as seen and not verified. Running head taken as "CONCIONES"; a small symbol follows it, probably an ornament, not included. Page number printed as "44²", read as 442. The word "deles" below the last line is the catchword for "fideles", and the text ends on the hyphenated half-word "fi-". Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout.
